page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn9gc-2x.16xlarge belongs to the Compute Optimized with GPU instance family, built on KVM virtualization and the x86_64 architecture. The server provides 64 dedicated vCPUs powered by AMD EPYC 9A75 processors running at a base clock speed of 3.3 GHz. Memory capacity totals 384.0 GB of system RAM, which provides an allocation of 6.0 GB per core across the host compute resources.

Hardware acceleration is provisioned through two NVIDIA Blackwell architecture GPUs that deliver an aggregate of 144 GB of VRAM. High-speed host communication is supported by a 64 Gbps baseline network bandwidth. The instance provides no integrated local storage, requiring users to attach external cloud storage volumes for all OS installations, caches, and persistent file operations. No complimentary public IPv4 addresses are provisioned by default.

From an infrastructure perspective, the server balances dual high-end GPU accelerators with substantial dedicated CPU parallelism and high system memory. Resource efficiency is tied to maximizing GPU and CPU utilization concurrently; workloads that do not leverage accelerator hardware will leave considerable resource capacity unused. Primary workload fits include deep learning model training, large language model inference pipelines, GPU-accelerated computer vision, and parallel scientific simulation workloads.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn9gc-2x.16xlarge is a GPU-accelerated compute instance featuring 64 dedicated x86_64 vCPUs powered by AMD EPYC 9A75 processors clocked at 3.3 GHz. It is equipped with 384.0 GB of system memory, providing 6.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. Hardware acceleration is delivered by two NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs supplying a combined 144 GB of VRAM. Networking capabilities offer a baseline throughput of 64 Gbps on a KVM hypervisor foundation. The instance contains no onboard local storage, requiring attached network volumes for persistent filesystem operations, and includes zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses. With dense GPU memory capacity and dedicated host CPU execution, the platform provides strong resource alignment for demanding parallel computational tasks. Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn9gc-2x.16xlarge is designed for deep learning model training, high-throughput LLM inference, video processing pipelines, and large-scale scientific simulation workloads requiring substantial GPU memory bandwidth.
